name: band
//turns: These have feet, so they turn round on the beat, each on its own count. See wordsTurning.
//: Eight instruments with arms and legs, dancing, in place of a set assembled out of an icon library. The idea is the listener's and it is what made the set work: a row of instruments standing still is a shop window, and the same instruments dancing are a band. Every one of them has feet, so every one of them turns round on the beat.
//marks: The order is the sound, low at the left and high at the right, and the row comes to 164 cells at 36 dots — which an ordinary terminal holds, so all eight are drawn large.
